title: Full Virtual File System
description: Make semio/rs FileSystemNode the single source of truth for the virtual file system. Extend with Representation/Port/Connector nodes and fileSystemHasChildren. Rewire sketchpad kit/design VFS to lazy-load children over GraphQL.
summary: Made semio/rs FileSystemNode the VFS source of truth: added REPRESENTATION/PORT/CONNECTOR kinds, Type children, fileSystemHasChildren, and VFS impls on Port/Connector/Representation. Updated GraphQL golden/working schemas. Extended semio/js vfsKitFields + fetchSemioFileSystemChildren; re-exported from semio/react. Added VirtualFileSystemController.virtualFileSystemUsesAsyncChildren + loadChildrenAsync (sync fallback when false). Rewired sketchpad kit/design VFS to GraphQL via loadChildrenAsync with InMemorySemioKitStore fallback; raw entity ids; schema icons for new kinds. Extended ui/react virtualFileSystemKindIcon and VirtualFileSystem story. Tests: framework core (13), @semio/js (16), sketchpad VFS (3), rs type VFS children.
